title: Candice Event Envelope
description: Shared envelope for all Candice companion events (question, answer, status). Each concrete event schema re-declares its own fields (no $ref across files, for standalone validation), and this envelope documents the common discriminators: schemaVersion, sessionId, skill (question/status only), and event. The companion rejects events with an unknown schemaVersion. Candice Master Spec section 14. Version: 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the event schema. Consumers reject unknown versions; producers must not silently downgrade.

sessionId.description: Opaque Claude Code session identifier. Routing authority; never derived from window position.

skill.description: The supported BlackCEO skill that invoked Candice. Absent on answer events (the answer echoes the question's key instead).

event.description: Event discriminator. Every event is exactly one of these three.
